Name: piston fist
Text: deal 1 damage to chosen unit and chosen allied unit gains +1 power until end of turn

Name: bring it down
Text: deal 2 damage to chosen non-scratch asset

Name: visionary's insight
Text: regroup up to one chosen exhausted asset.

Name: mage seeker's inquisition
Text: Chosen player reveals their hand and discards a unit of your choice.

Name: railway reinforcements
Text: move up to 3 chosen allied units from your reserves to the main theater

Name: redline infusion
Text: chosen allied unit gets +2 power and gains berserk until end of turn. At the end of your turn, kill that unit.

Name: dolus infusion
Text: draw 2 cards and your headquarters heals 2.

Name: inspired salvage
Text: return up to 2 mechanized cards from your discard pile to your hand

Name: fire for effect
Text:
opposing assets in the main theater gain resistant -1 until the end of your turn. 
deal 1 damage to chosen asset in the main theater.

Name: macrocannon barrage
Text: deal 5 damage distributed among up to 5 chosen units

Name: Armored Charge
Text: Regroup chosen allied Mechanized unit. It heals 5 and gains 2 armor.

Name: All out War
Text:
Discard your hand, then:
- chosen allied asset gains power equal to the number of cards discarded this way until the end of your turn.
- scratch a number of times equal to the number of cards discarded this way.
- regroup all scratch company units in your reserves.

Name: March of progress
Text: up to 2 chosen units gain the Mechanized type until end of turn. Allied Mechanized units gain 2 armor and gets +2 power until end of turn.
